statement.p: (a) Find a parametric equation for the line through the point \left(3,5,3\right) and in the direction of a\vec i +b\vec j+c\vec k.

(b) Find conditions on a,b,c so that the line you found in part (a) goes through the origin. (Be sure you can give a reason for your answer.) Then use your work to give two distinct triples a,b,c that result in the line passing through the origin.

static.solution:
(a) Parametric equations are x = 3 + a t,\quad y = 5 + b t,\quad z = 3 + c t, or \vec r(t) = (3 + a t)\,\vec i + (5 + b t)\,\vec j + (3 + c t)\,\vec k.
(b) The line goes through the origin if the position vector 3 \vec i + 5 \vec j + 3 \vec k is parallel to the vector a\vec i +b\vec j +c\vec k. This occurs if a,b,c are in the ratio 3:5:3; that is if \frac a{3} =\frac b {5} =\frac c{3}. Any values satisfying this are appropriate.
